business_summary: CoreWeave, Inc. operates AI-focused neocloud data centers and accelerated-compute infrastructure, a business built specifically around renting GPU capacity to AI customers rather than general-purpose cloud or colocation. It sits on the hyperscale-datacenters link only, and is the most recently public name in this batch.

exposure_summary.narrative: ABI Research's 2025 operator census identifies CoreWeave as a neocloud data-center operator with active U.S. capacity, a direct and effectively pure-play placement, with no other business line diluting the exposure the way it is diluted for the hyperscalers on this same link.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for COREWEAVE carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/CRWV.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals.revenue_fy does not carry a clean three-fiscal-year-prior data point matched to the latest entry; revenue CAGR cannot be computed without inventing an intermediate figure.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss -46000000 divided by Revenues 5131000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 3058000000 divided by net income -1167000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 3058000000 less capital expenditure 10309000000, divided by revenue 5131000000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 11788000000 (total debt 17312000000 as of 2026-03-31 less cash 5524000000 as of 2026-06-30) divided by an EBITDA proxy 2408000000 (operating income -46000000 plus depreciation 2454000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CRWV.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 3 (state WEAK) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/CRWV.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CRWV.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score 0.117, earnings-manipulation state REVIEW, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/CRWV.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 36724280000.0 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 436000000 (as of 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 84.23 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/CRWV.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CRWV.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 36724280000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 5131000000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CRWV.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 48512280000.0 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 5131000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: data/market/CRWV.json quality.reverse_dcf did not solve an implied FCF CAGR: base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless.

horizon_spread.basis: data/market/CRWV.json quality.reverse_dcf did not solve, so no horizon spread across implied_by_horizon periods is available either: base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless.

crowdedness_caveats: hyperscale-datacenters is chain-heat CROWDED, and CoreWeave's IPO and subsequent trading have themselves been a widely covered story rather than an undiscovered name.
Piotroski F-score of 3 (WEAK) and a Beneish M-score of 0.117 (state REVIEW, above the -1.78 threshold) are the weakest fundamentals-quality read in this entire batch.

catalysts.claim: ABI Research's 2025 operator census names CoreWeave directly as a neocloud data-center operator with active U.S. capacity, the clearest pure-play AI-datacenter placement in this batch.
catalysts.source_name: ABI Research U.S. data-center operator census

catalysts.claim: Revenue grew from $229M to $1.915B to $5.131B over the three reported fiscal years, an extraordinarily fast ramp even though the three-year CAGR formula used elsewhere in this batch cannot be applied to a base that started near zero.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json

risks.claim: GAAP operating margin is negative (-0.9%), net income is -$1.167B, and free cash flow margin is -141.3% on fiscal 2025 figures: capital expenditure of $10.31B exceeds revenue itself, the most capital-intensive, cash-burning profile in this entire batch.
risks.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CRWV.json

risks.claim: Net debt to EBITDA of 4.90x combined with a Beneish M-score in the REVIEW band (0.117, above the -1.78 threshold) and a WEAK Piotroski score of 3 together make this the highest-risk fundamentals profile among the fifteen names profiled this run.

data_gaps: growth.revenue_cagr_3y is NULL: a three-year CAGR formula is not meaningful on a revenue base that started near zero two fiscal years ago.
reverse_dcf is NULL: base-year free cash flow is negative, so the solve reports NOT_APPLICABLE rather than a figure.

No customer-concentration disclosure is on file in this store; CoreWeave's publicly reported business is understood to be concentrated among a small number of large AI customers, but no dated sourced figure for that concentration is present here.
No data/edgar/docs/CRWV.json filing is on disk this run.

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the hyperscale-datacenters link's zero-coverage gap. Retained at O2: the clearest pure-play exposure on this link, but also the weakest fundamentals-quality read of the whole batch (WEAK Piotroski, REVIEW-band Beneish, negative FCF), so it needs careful independent scrutiny rather than acceleration.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
